name: agent-harness
description: A coordinator plus three roles (researcher, implementer, evaluator) with a session budget, an accident catcher and an audit trace. Stack-agnostic: project facts live in one marked block of AGENTS.md. Enforcement wired for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinator + three roles, with enforcement that holds when instructions don't.
interface.longDescription: Turns Codex into a coordinator that plans, delegates to a researcher, an implementer and an evaluator, and refuses work the evaluator hasn't passed. Stack-agnostic: everything about your project lives in one marked block of AGENTS.md, and one AGENTS.md per package — never behind an @import, which Codex cannot resolve. Ships the harness-adoption skill and a hook layer: a session tool-call budget, an accident catcher, an audit trace under .agent/, and format-on-write driven by a .claude/format.map.json you write in your own project (no map, no formatting). The sandbox and approval policy are project settings and do not travel with the plugin — copy .codex/config.toml into your project.
defaultPrompt: Add pagination to the /users endpoint, with tests.
Research how the OpenAPI contract is wired before changing it.
